title: Rejoice with Great Joy
speaker: Ps Andrew Cartledge
blurb:
Betsy Ten Boom thanked God for the fleas. Corey drew the line. Eventually she relented. Months later, they found out the fleas were the reason the guards never entered the barracks, which meant the Bible studies could continue, and women kept coming to Jesus in one of the darkest places on earth.

Ps Andrew Cartledge builds toward something in this sermon that starts with a memory problem, moves through a concentration camp, stops at the tomb of a four-day-dead Lazarus, and arrives at a single Greek word that connects grace coming down with thanks going up. The connection is tighter than it sounds, and the Nehemiah passage he lands on reframes what it means to bring a sacrifice and what happens after you do.

Giving thanks before you can see a single reason to. That's where this one lives.
